tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-B043-001 repaired guard parses under real Bash 3 and Bash 5 on identical bytes
tests.description: Run the desired dual-parser assertion against one frozen source hash. Preserve the initial nonzero RED when Bash 3.2 rejects the frozen defect, then require both parser exits to be zero after repair.

tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-B043-002 source-derived fixture crosses the former Bash 3 recovery boundary
tests.description: Extract the complete Check 7C assignment and exact Check 16 heading from unique current-source anchors. Append the named sentinel and require exactly one emission from each repaired interpreter leg.

tests.testTitle: Mutation: SCN-B043-002 exact outer-quote restoration recreates the parser divergence
tests.description: Restore only the redundant opening and closing assignment quotes exactly once in a private copy. Preserve every heredoc byte and assert the closed repaired-versus-mutant parse and sentinel matrix.
tests.negativeControl: Restore the opening quote before the Check 7C command substitution and the closing quote after its closing parenthesis exactly once.

tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-B043-003 supported-runtime transition verdicts remain unchanged
tests.description: Run the complete existing transition guard selftest under supported Bash. Reject any bypass, skipped check, applicability drift, severity drift, or verdict drift.

tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-B043-004 installed transition guard matches source bytes and parser parity
tests.description: Generate the release manifest, install into a private downstream fixture, compare source and installed guard hashes, and run both real parser legs against the installed bytes.

tests.testTitle: Regression: BUG-043 framework validation and release readiness preserve parser and propagation contracts
tests.description: Run full framework validation and release readiness on the final source bytes after all focused parser, semantic, and installer checks pass.
tests.command: bash bubbles/scripts/cli.sh framework-validate && bash bubbles/scripts/cli.sh release-check
